annotations.text: Heat strip - the lead concept. heating_power and is_heating are custom capabilities of this app, so no built-in Homey widget can draw them. Readings are sample data; room names come from the Smart Gulvvarme account, which is why they are Danish.

Colours, type ramp and spacing are Homey's published widget tokens at their exact values. The orange is Homey's own --homey-color-orange (#ff8400); the accent chip above each artboard swaps it for the app's brand orange (#f36b21) or any other.
How three of them sit together in one dashboard column.
